text:
Sam: quick shoutout — Lina brought her toolkit and fixed the standing desk motor in the 4th-floor lounge during lunch. Turned an actual tiny crisis into a plant party. thank you!! :raised_hands:
Lina: lol I couldn't leave the sagging bookshelf to fend for itself. Also moved a ficus to a sunnier spot 🌞
Raj: that ficus is thriving already. major props Lina. you eat snacks yet? :taco:
Maya: shoutout to Janet in facilities — coordinated the ladder and safety tape so this didn't become a circus 🙏
Janet (facilities): happy to help! quick reminder: if anyone wants to borrow my toolkit, DM me and sign the log. also stickers for plant care available 🪴
office-bot: :partyparrot:  Reaction added: :tada: by Sam
Sam: also, huge thanks to Raj for volunteering coffee runs while Lina worked — team effort 
Raj: coffee = fuel. will accept payment in gratitude and leftover cookies 🍪
Maya: can we have a tiny poll — name the ficus? options: 'Spoke', 'Byte', 'Fernando' 
Sam: 1) Spoke 2) Byte 3) Fernando — I vote Byte
Lina: Fernando for the dramatic lean. :laughing:
Raj: Fernando it is. congrats fernando. grateful for the quick teamwork — warms my whole week :heart:
Maya: tagging #all-hands later with a pic for micro-kudos, unless anyone objects
Sam: do it! tiny victories matter. :sparkles:
Lina: thanks everyone — feel very appreciated. :hugging_face:
